problem.original_text:
Consider the system
$$\dot{x}=x(1-x)-\alpha xy, \quad \dot{y}=\beta y(1-y)-\gamma xy$$
with parameters $$\alpha=1.2,\ \beta=0.9,\ \gamma=1.1.$$  
(a) Find all equilibrium points in the real plane.  
(b) Compute the Jacobian at each equilibrium and classify stability using eigenvalues.  
(c) Include a phase portrait plot showing trajectories and equilibrium points for $$x,y\in[0,2].$$
problem.normalized_text:
Consider the system
$$\dot{x}=x(1-x)-\alpha xy, \quad \dot{y}=\beta y(1-y)-\gamma xy$$
with parameters $$\alpha=1.2,\ \beta=0.9,\ \gamma=1.1.$$  
(a) Find all equilibrium points in the real plane.  
(b) Compute the Jacobian at each equilibrium and classify stability using eigenvalues.  
(c) Include a phase portrait plot showing trajectories and equilibrium points for $$x,y\in[0,2].$$

steps.title: Find equilibrium conditions
steps.explanation: Set right-hand sides to zero: x(1-x)-α x y=0 and β y(1-y)-γ x y=0. Factor x and y where possible to get candidates.

steps.title: List equilibria from factor cases
steps.explanation: Consider x=0 or 1-x-α y=0 combined with y=0 or β(1-y)-γ x=0 to get all intersections.
math_latex: plus interior solution solving linear system from 1-x-α y=0 and \beta(1-y)-\gamma x=0

steps.title: Solve for interior equilibrium
steps.explanation: Solve linear 1-x-α y=0 and β(1-y)-γ x=0 for x,y using given parameters.

steps.title: Compute numeric interior point
steps.explanation: Substitute x into second equation and solve for y, then x with α=1.2,β=0.9,γ=1.1.

steps.title: Numeric interior solution
steps.explanation: Solve 0.42 y = 0.2 to get y, then x=1-1.2 y.

steps.title: Jacobian matrix
steps.explanation: Compute Jacobian J = [[∂f/∂x,∂f/∂y],[∂g/∂x,∂g/∂y]] with f=x(1-x)-α x y, g=β y(1-y)-γ x y.

steps.title: Evaluate Jacobian at boundary equilibria
steps.explanation: Plug in (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) to get eigenvalues from diagonal or 2×2 forms.

steps.title: Evaluate J at (0,1) and interior
steps.explanation: Compute J(0,1) and J(x*,y*) numerically and find eigenvalues to classify stability.
